about: Routing corpus for scripts/routing-eval.mjs. Each case is what a user actually says, not what the tool is called; 'expect' is the tool that should be reached for first, 'alsoFine' names calls that are a reasonable first step towards it (usually a listing tool that finds the id the expected tool needs). Anything else is a misroute. Cases tagged 'probe' exist to separate a pair the name-similarity analysis flagged as confusable; keep them when editing descriptions, because they are what proves the edit worked.
